name: silence-map
description: Find amplitude-defined quiet intervals in a supplied mono or stereo MP3/WAV clip. Export quiet and unmarked intervals as CSV, Audacity quiet labels, JSON and a timeline plot in a ZIP. Set a threshold from -60 to -20 dBFS and a minimum quiet run from 0.1–2 seconds. Clips must be 0.1–120 seconds, at most 20 MB and up to 96 kHz. Quiet does not mean speech is absent; unmarked intervals may include shorter quiet runs. This tool does not classify speech, transcribe, cut, denoise or modify audio. Timing starts at zero on the decoded sample timeline. Requires a connected account; derived marker and plot exports are public.
